== List of foreign players in the league ==
This is a list of foreign players in the 2020–21 season. The following players:

# Have played at least one game for the respective club.
# Have not been capped for the [[Costa Rica national football team]] on any level, independently from the birthplace

A new rule was introduced this season, that clubs can have four foreign players per club and can only add a new player if there is an injury or a player is released and it's before the close of the season transfer window.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.unafut.com/index.php/estadisticas-fpd/extranjeros |title=UNAFUT - SITIO OFICIAL - Extranjeros |access-date=2020-12-24 |archive-date=2021-01-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210121144502/http://unafut.com/index.php/estadisticas-fpd/extranjeros |url-status=dead }}</ref>
